decisions.reason: BASE drops 역시 (‘after all’); SOL drops interrogative 인가 and makes the thought a certainty.
decisions.replacement: *…So it is a dark art after all?*

decisions.reason: SOL keeps 한두 번 as ‘first or second time’ and tightens the spoken beat; BASE flattens the idiom.
SOL preserves 역대급 수치 플레이; BASE genericizes it and adds ‘of my life.’
Korean is 일 층; SOL’s ‘downstairs’ drops the stated floor.
SOL’s ‘Yeah?’ matches casual 그래?; BASE’s ‘He is?’ is an unsupported echo.
점소이 is an inn waiter; ‘waiter’ fits the setting better than modern ‘server.’
‘Thugs’ matches 불한당 and ‘crack … open’ matches 뚝배기를 깨다; BASE’s ‘villains’ / ‘smash … in’ are looser.
SOL’s ‘What,’ maps to 왜,; BASE’s ‘What about it?’ is not in the Korean.
SOL renders protest-marker 아니 as ‘Wait,’; BASE omits it.
BASE is the natural clarification; SOL’s ‘By what happened earlier’ is stiff and redundant after the prior line.
SOL’s ‘If it’s about that’ tracks 그거라면; BASE’s ‘If that’s what you mean’ is extra meta.
알고 계시네요 is a realization that he already knew, not BASE’s question.
SOL keeps the clipped 옝다, 이유 toss; BASE pads with ‘This is.’
Korean is 낡은 서책; BASE inserts glossary ‘martial arts manual’ (비급) the sentence does not use.
BASE already names the clan’s Flame Divine Palm manual clearly; SOL’s dash equates the 무공 with the 비급.
SOL’s ‘Right?’ matches 그치? and Taekyung’s casual tag; ‘Don’t you think?’ is stiffer.
BASE omits 심지어; SOL’s ‘And’ under-renders it. ‘Even’ carries the additive.
decisions.replacement: “Even if Jopil was Great Hero Jeok’s Disciple, we merely did our duty. He was even the one who charged at us and tried to kill us first.”

decisions.reason: SOL keeps 꿀꺽 as ‘swallow’ and the rhetorical ‘who’d want to’; BASE substitutes ‘keep it.’
BASE glosses 가늘고 길게 as ‘uneventful,’ breaking the thin-and-long shit punchline SOL preserves.
BASE keeps the doubled 그거, 그거 stammer; SOL collapses the panic.
SOL’s clipped ‘Why bring that up all of a sudden?’ matches truncated 갑자기 그건 왜.
BASE’s ‘my body draped over the window’ is a 몸을 calque; SOL’s ‘leaning’ dangles onto the face instead of Taekyung.
decisions.replacement: A wrinkled face suddenly appeared. It looked up at me as I leaned out over the windowsill, and grinned.
